<p>Returns true if this function's address is escaped in a way that might make it an indirect call target.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/function/#a1b87b14bb6dd4f14bb42c73d2085673e">Function::hasAddressTaken</a> gives different results when a function is called directly with a function prototype mismatch, which requires a cast.</p>
